text: ふなのりの　おれと　しょうぶだ！

structure.jp: ふなのりの　おれと

patterns.name: 〜の (same thing)
patterns.explanation: の here doesn't mean 'of'. It says the two words are the same person. ふなのりの おれ = 'me, a sailor'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person means 'with' or 'against' that person. おれと しょうぶ = 'a battle with me'.
